title: Илгээх бичгийн бэлтгэл
notice: Түр загвар — үндэсний батлагдсан маягт биш. Зөвхөн зохиомол өгөгдөлтэй туршилт.

fields.label: Өвчтөн, үзлэгийн мэдээлэл
fields.instruction: Patient and encounter identifiers, manually entered only.

fields.label: Илгээх / хүлээн авах байгууллага, эмч
fields.instruction: Sending and receiving facility and doctor, manually entered only.

fields.label: Зовиур, өвчний түүх
fields.instruction: Presenting symptoms and history, with negatives and uncertainty.

fields.label: Үзлэг, амин үзүүлэлт
fields.instruction: Physical examination and vital signs explicitly recorded.

fields.label: Шинжилгээ
fields.instruction: Investigations, results, or explicit statements that testing was not done.

fields.label: Эхэд бичигдсэн онош
fields.instruction: Only an explicitly documented diagnosis, including tentative or ruled-out diagnoses with original uncertainty. Never infer a diagnosis from symptoms.

fields.label: Хийгдсэн эмчилгээ, хэрэглэж буй эм
fields.instruction: Treatment already provided or current medication, doses, units and times. No new recommendations.

fields.label: Харшлын мэдээлэл
fields.instruction: Allergies including explicitly absent, unknown, or not assessed.

fields.label: Илгээх шалтгаан, хүлээн авах эмчид тавих хүсэлт
fields.instruction: Only the source's explicit referral reason/request. Do not decide eligibility, urgency, diagnosis, or treatment.
